html:
A journalist and politician, known as Zik, who led the fight for Nigerian independence and became the country's first governor-general in 1960 and first president in 1963.

Trained in the United States, he founded the West African Pilot newspaper in Lagos in 1937 and led the National Council of Nigeria and the Cameroons. Nigeria became independent on 1 October 1960, with Abubakar Tafawa Balewa as prime minister. Azikiwe's post was mostly ceremonial; the military coup of 1966 ended his presidency. An Igbo, he backed Biafra at first, then returned to the federal side. He founded the University of Nigeria at Nsukka. See also Nkrumah, whom he inspired.
